transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because things at work have been feeling... targeted. I drive routes, and I’m pretty sure dispatch and compliance are tracking when I change them through the computer system. Then I’ll hear little comments over the radio that line up with what I’m doing. People tell me it’s just normal oversight, but I can tell some of the other drivers are reporting on me.
Do you feel that these comments or actions from dispatch or other drivers are intentionally meant to harm or target you personally?

Yes. I do feel like it’s aimed at me personally. Like when I change my route, dispatch and compliance seem to know right away through the system, and then I’ll hear comments on the radio that match what I just did. People say it’s just normal tracking, but it doesn’t feel that way. It feels like certain drivers are reporting on me.
Do you feel that these comments or actions are specifically directed at you even when there’s no clear reason for it?

Yes. That’s what bothers me—there isn’t always an obvious reason, but it still feels like it’s meant for me. Like I’ll change something on my route, and then dispatch or compliance seems to react through the system, or I hear some little comment over the radio that lines up with it. And even if people say it’s just normal oversight, I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me.
Do you feel that things people say or do—like over the radio or in conversations—have special meaning or are directed at you, even when others might not see it that way?

Yes. That’s how it feels. Like the radio comments aren’t just random—they line up too closely with what I’m doing on my route. And when I change something, dispatch or compliance seems to know through the computer system. Other people say it’s normal oversight, but to me it feels directed at me, like certain drivers are reporting on me.
Do you feel that things people say or do outside of work also have special meaning or are directed at you?

Mostly it’s at work. That’s where I notice it—the dispatch system, compliance watching the route changes, and then the little comments over the radio. Outside of work, I don’t really have the same clear feeling. It’s more tied to certain drivers reporting on me and what happens on my routes.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being controlled by someone else or that thoughts are being put into your mind?

Not really like thoughts being put in my mind, no. It’s more that I feel watched or tracked—like dispatch and compliance can see when I change my route through the computer system, and then I’ll hear little comments on the radio that seem connected. People tell me it’s just normal oversight, but I can tell some drivers are reporting on me.

Have you ever felt that events, objects, or people’s actions in your personal life or in the world around you have a special meaning or are directed at you specifically, even when others don’t see it that way?

Mostly it’s with work, not really my personal life. I’m here because it feels like dispatch and compliance are tracking my route changes through the computer system. Then I hear little comments on the radio that seem to match up with what I’m doing. People say it’s just normal oversight, but I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me.
Do you ever feel that your private thoughts are being shared with others without you saying them out loud, or that others can somehow know what you’re thinking?

Not exactly like they can hear my thoughts. It’s more that they seem to know what I’m doing with my routes before I say anything. Like dispatch and compliance track the changes through the system, and then I hear comments over the radio that line up with it. People say it’s just normal oversight, but I can tell some drivers are reporting on me.
Outside of work, do you ever feel that things people say or do—like things on TV, in conversations, or in the environment—have special meaning or are directed at you specifically?

No, not really outside of work. I don’t think the TV or random conversations are sending me messages or anything like that. It’s mainly at work—like with dispatch and compliance seeing my route changes in the system, and then certain comments on the radio seem tied to what I’m doing. Even when people say it’s just normal oversight, I feel like some drivers are reporting on me.
Have you ever felt that your actions, like changing your route, are being controlled by an outside force or that someone is making you do things against your will?

No, I don’t feel like someone is controlling my body or making me do the route changes. I’m the one choosing the route. It’s more that when I do change it, dispatch and compliance seem to be tracking it through the computer, and then I hear little comments on the radio that match what I’m doing. And I can tell some drivers are reporting on me, even though people keep saying it’s just normal oversight.
